gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Noto Sans Thaana has wide channels leading into every counter, so its big lowercase forms feel approachable and easy to enter. Visitor does the shouting with tubelike, constant-weight lines; the body does the talking.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-thai: Pixel-era swagger, then soft beads. Visitor's round bowls keep one outline from start to finish, while Noto Sans Thai swells its lowercase like inflated glass and leaves the rounds open, a sans-serif that gives the stiff heading room to breathe.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-thai-loo: Visitor looks like bent tubing, gaping mouths on every e. Its strongest quality is how that stubby, digital heading sits over Noto Sans Thai Looped, a plain sans whose tall bodies and spacious curve gaps look bold yet open.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Visitor draws its strokes with the steadiness of a string pulled taut, all gaping e mouths and short ascenders. Noto Sans Tifinagh follows with rounded, open lowercase bowls that fill the line, though shrinking the heading would cost it that blocky punch.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Retro pixels meet crisp modern cuts. Visitor's lowercase a drops every hairline, and Noto Sans Tirhuta, a sans-serif with a dominant x-height and terminals trimmed back to big gaps, makes the strongest part of the pair: a heading and body that both feel blunt and open.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Nostalgic is the first word that comes to mind with Visitor, whose curves match its stems exactly. Noto Sans Ugaritic sits close to a flat line, with little gap between x-height and caps, so enlarging the body would crowd the heading's quirks.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-vai: Modern warmth shows in Noto Sans Vai, where words form solid blocks instead of skylines, under Visitor's diagonals as thick as its horizontals. Its strongest quality is that plain sans, block-like steadiness.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Clean lines run through both fonts: Visitor draws its bowls at stem thickness, while Noto Sans Vithkuqi opens the throats of a, c, e and s with hardly any step up to caps. Let the body font run a touch larger.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Visitor draws plain, unmodulated outlines with gaping e mouths. Beneath it, Noto Sans Wancho brings a hulking lowercase like thick chalk pressed hard, and its wide-gapped e keeps the page from feeling crushed.
gen-dafont-visitor-gf-noto-sans-warang-c: Visitor's horizontals and verticals match in thickness, like rod stock, with gaping e mouths and short ascenders. Noto Sans Warang Citi sets words as solid blocks, and that shared bluntness is the pair's strongest quality.
